document.title: Student Loan Interest Statement
document.issued_by: the lender / recipient of the student loan interest

boxes.label: Student loan interest received by lender
If checked, box 1 does not include loan origination fees and/or capitalized interest for loans made before September 1, 2004
CORRECTED (if checked)
boxes.note: A corrected form REPLACES the one it corrects for the same account: the two are never both counted. Which copy stands is a person's call, made by reading the two side by side.

boxes.label: VOID
boxes.note: Printed on Copy A (the IRS's copy) only; a recipient's copy carries no VOID box. Declared so a Copy A that reaches the packet is recognised for what it is - a form that reports nothing.

boxes.label: Account number (see instructions)
boxes.note: May show an account or other unique number the lender assigned to distinguish the borrower's account - what tells two of one lender's forms apart.

document.notes: Where box 2 is checked the borrower may have MORE deductible interest than box 1 reports, because loan origination fees and capitalized interest on pre-September-1-2004 loans are deductible but are not in box 1. Box 1 is therefore a floor, not a ceiling, in that case.
